verbatim.cn: "驾驶中点击空调控制需要2-3秒才响应，太危险了。"

verbatim.en: "Car forced a 45-minute update right when I needed to leave for work."
verbatim.cn: "出门上班时车子强制安装了45分钟的更新，完全没有预警。"

verbatim.en: "It keeps setting navigation to wrong addresses when I speak clearly."
verbatim.cn: "明明说得很清楚，导航还是导错地方。"

verbatim.en: "Apple CarPlay disconnects every 20 minutes on longer drives."
verbatim.cn: "长途驾驶中CarPlay每20分钟就断一次。"

verbatim.en: "System told me to turn 100m after the actual junction."
verbatim.cn: "系统在真实路口100米后才提示转向。"

verbatim.en: "Backup camera is useless at night — just a blurry dark rectangle."
verbatim.cn: "夜间倒车摄像头完全没用，就是模糊的黑色方块。"

verbatim.en: "Paid $60k for the car and now they want $200/yr for remote lock. Unacceptable."
verbatim.cn: "花60万买的车，远程解锁还要额外收钱，无法接受。"

verbatim.en: "HUD is invisible with morning sun directly ahead."
verbatim.cn: "早晨阳光直射时HUD完全看不见。"

verbatim.en: "It takes 5 taps to turn on heated seats. Why no physical buttons?"
verbatim.cn: "打开座椅加热要点5次屏幕，为什么不给实体按键？"

verbatim.en: "Automatic emergency braking triggered at a shadow on the road."
verbatim.cn: "自动紧急制动被路面阴影误触发。"

verbatim.en: "Screen dims automatically in the sun so you can't see it at all."
verbatim.cn: "屏幕在阳光下自动降亮，什么都看不见。"

verbatim.en: "The system lags so badly that I gave up on voice commands entirely."
verbatim.cn: "系统卡顿严重，语音指令完全放弃使用了。"

verbatim.en: "Parking mode dashcam killed my car battery in 3 days."
verbatim.cn: "停车监控模式3天就把汽车电瓶耗光了。"

verbatim.en: "The OEM app crashes every time I try to pre-cool the car remotely."
verbatim.cn: "每次用原厂APP远程预冷车内温度时都会崩溃。"

verbatim.en: "Asked it to call 'Mom' — called 'Tom' instead."
verbatim.cn: "让它拨打'妈妈'，结果拨给了'小明'。"

verbatim.en: "Android Auto drops every time I go through a tunnel."
verbatim.cn: "每次过隧道Android Auto就断开了。"

verbatim.en: "Navigation recalculates so slowly I missed my exit."
verbatim.cn: "导航重新规划太慢，过了出口才提示。"

verbatim.en: "Update notification appeared while I was reversing."
verbatim.cn: "倒车时突然弹出更新通知。"

verbatim.en: "Why is live traffic a subscription? It was free with my old car."
verbatim.cn: "实时路况为什么要收订阅费？我的老车是免费的。"

verbatim.en: "Phantom braking twice in one week — I don't trust it anymore."
verbatim.cn: "一周内幽灵刹车两次，已经不信任这个功能了。"

verbatim.en: "The UI is beautiful but so slow. Feels like a 2015 tablet."
verbatim.cn: "UI很漂亮但是非常卡，感觉像2015年的平板电脑。"

verbatim.en: "My phone disconnects within minutes of connecting via USB-C."
verbatim.cn: "USB-C连接几分钟后手机就断开了。"

verbatim.en: "It understands 'navigate home' maybe 50% of the time."
verbatim.cn: "'导航回家'大概只有50%的识别成功率。"

verbatim.en: "Map doesn't show construction zones added last month."
verbatim.cn: "地图还没有更新上个月新增的施工区域。"

verbatim.en: "Finding the tire pressure display requires 4 menu levels."
verbatim.cn: "查看胎压显示需要进入4层菜单。"

verbatim.en: "Update took 2 hours and I couldn't drive the car."
verbatim.cn: "更新花了2小时，期间完全无法用车。"

verbatim.en: "360 surround view is completely black in dark parking lots."
verbatim.cn: "在昏暗停车场360环视全黑看不见任何东西。"

verbatim.en: "HUD reflects on the windshield at night and creates double image."
verbatim.cn: "夜间HUD在挡风玻璃上产生重影。"

verbatim.en: "Sentry mode uses so much power it's not worth enabling."
verbatim.cn: "哨兵模式耗电太多，根本不值得开启。"
